# Sparkly Space Cleaning Services

> Professional domestic, deep cleaning, end of tenancy, Airbnb and holiday let, and commercial cleaning across Bournemouth, Poole and Christchurch in Dorset, UK.

## Overview
Sparkly Space Cleaning Services provides tailored cleaning for homes, holiday lets, offices and end of tenancy changeovers. Every quote is prepared for the job, based on property size, condition, access and what is needed. Photos, a short video or a walkthrough may be requested first so the quote is accurate.

## Services
- **Residential & Domestic Cleaning**: Regular weekly or fortnightly home cleaning tailored to the client's routine. https://sparklyspace.co.uk/services/residential-cleaning
- **Deep Cleaning**: A thorough top-to-bottom clean covering limescale, built-up dust, skirting boards and hard-to-reach areas. https://sparklyspace.co.uk/services/deep-cleaning
- **End of Tenancy Cleaning**: A deep clean of the whole property to a landlord or letting agent checkout checklist. https://sparklyspace.co.uk/services/end-of-tenancy-cleaning
- **Airbnb & Holiday Let Cleaning**: Turnover cleaning between guests, with linen, restocking, key coordination and damage checks reported with photos. https://sparklyspace.co.uk/services/airbnb-cleaning
- **Commercial & Office Cleaning**: Scheduled cleaning for offices, retail units and gyms, outside working hours if needed. https://sparklyspace.co.uk/services/commercial-cleaning
- **Custom & Specialist Cleaning**: Post-builder cleaning, carpet deep cleaning, window cleaning and one-off jobs, quoted to a custom checklist. https://sparklyspace.co.uk/services/custom-cleaning
- **Eco-Conscious Options**: Non-toxic, child-safe and pet-friendly products on request.

## Service Area
- **Main areas**: Bournemouth (BH1–BH11), Poole (BH12–BH18) and Christchurch (BH23).
  - Bournemouth: https://sparklyspace.co.uk/bournemouth
  - Poole: https://sparklyspace.co.uk/poole
  - Christchurch: https://sparklyspace.co.uk/christchurch
- **Nearby postcodes**: Ferndown and Wimborne (BH21, BH22) and Purbeck and Wareham (BH19, BH20) are also covered. Postcode checks are available on the booking page. Properties outside BH1–BH23 can get in touch to ask.

## Trust & Policies
- **24-hour re-clean guarantee**: If a corner is missed, tell the team within 24 hours and it will be re-cleaned free of charge.
- **Vetted staff**: Cleaners are vetted and background checked before their first clean.
- **Insurance**: Public liability insurance covers the home and contents.
- **Quotes**: Personalised quotes are sent via WhatsApp or email. Quotes are free and carry no obligation.
- **Reviews**: Customer reviews are on the Google Business Profile: https://share.google/Bz8bLAWN02yKv3zrD
